replication.target_description: Experiment 1: accuracy in sequential 2AFC matching; whole versus isolated feature probes, within 18 undergraduate participants, across unfamiliar, newly learned and famous faces; main effect of context in the 3 x 3 x 2 repeated-measures ANOVA.

n.sample_role: Participants in the repeated-measures context test; enrolled sample corroborated by F(1, 17).
n.exclusions: All participants recognised all famous faces; no items removed prior to analysis. No participant exclusions reported for Experiment 1.
n.location: Experiment 1, Method, Participants; Procedure final paragraph; Results and Discussion, context main effect.
n.quote: A total of 18 undergraduate students (16 females) participated in return for course credits.

es.location: Experiment 1, Results and Discussion, first paragraph immediately preceding Table 1.
es.quote: the analysis revealed a main effect of context (F(1, 17) = 14.45, p < .001) reflecting the expected complete-over-part advantage (CPA).
